label: MikroTik hAP ax² (C52iG-5HaxD2HaxD-TC)
description: MikroTik hAP ax² - 5x 1G RJ45, dual-band 802.11ax (574 Mbit/s on 2.4 GHz, 1200 Mbit/s on 5 GHz), with passive PoE-in and passive PoE-out on ether1.
notes: Vendor figures: 5x 10/100/1000 Ethernet ports, 1 of them with PoE-out; wireless 2.4 GHz 574 Mbit/s and 5 GHz 1200 Mbit/s (802.11ax). **The PoE-out port is ether1, not the last port** - MikroTik's hardware manual reads "PoE-out Passive PoE Ether1, max out per port output (input < 30 V): 600 mA", and the product table gives "Total output power 16.8W" against "Total output current 0.6" (0.6 A x 28 V, the top of the 18-28 V PoE-in range). The port sources a fixed input voltage rather than a negotiated 802.3af/at rail, so it is classed `passive`: two earlier copies of this box put the PoE-out on eth5 and called it `PoE+` (802.3at), which is a 48 V standard this port does not speak. This entry absorbed those two files (`hap-ax2.json`, `C52iG-5HaxD2HaxD.json`) - one product, one file.

poe.note: Total output power 16.8 W (product table, PoE-out block), one PoE-out port (ether1) on a 600 mA ceiling, passive PoE over the 18-28 V input. Manual: https://manual.mikrotik.com/hardware/hap-ax-2/
